name: 97701 · Bend, OR
findings: ZIP 97701 (Bend) has 177 nonprofit organizations. 95 of them (54%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 81 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 97701 (Bend) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
36% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 97701 (Bend) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 81 organizations here; 52% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
